title: hieracium longum
intro: Hieracium longum, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including being used to treat anxiety, depression, and insomnia, due to its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium longum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
